meta.title: M4th3m4t1c4 — Math adventures for young heroes
meta.description: Gamified Math for Ages 6 – 12. Follow a winding journey path, solve puzzles, earn stars and badges — while mastering addition, subtraction, multiplication and division.

hero.lead: Follow a winding journey path, solve puzzles, earn stars and badges — all while mastering addition, subtraction, multiplication and division.

features.title: Built for young learners
features.sub: Every design decision was made with elementary school children in mind — from type size to button spacing.

items.title: Journey Path
items.desc: Progress through 20+ hand-crafted levels on a winding map. Each level unlocks the next, keeping kids motivated to push forward.

items.title: All 4 Operations
items.desc: Addition, subtraction, multiplication and division — each with a dedicated adventure theme and progressive difficulty.

items.title: Stars & Badges
items.desc: Earn up to 3 stars per level and collect achievement badges. Visible progress keeps kids coming back every day.

items.title: Daily Streaks
items.desc: Build a practice habit with streaks that reward consistency. A 5-minute session every day beats a 35-minute session once a week.

items.title: Dark Mode
items.desc: A fully designed AMOLED dark theme that's easy on eyes during bedtime practice. Looks great at every time of day.

items.title: Instant Feedback
items.desc: Every answer gets immediate visual and audio feedback. Correct answers celebrate; wrong ones gently explain — no shame, just learning.

how.title: Three steps from download to math hero.

steps.title: Pick an operation
steps.desc: Choose from Addition Arena, Subtraction Safari, Multiplication Mountain, or Division Dash.

steps.title: Solve questions
steps.desc: Tap the big numpad to enter your answer. Every correct answer fills your star meter.

steps.title: Level up & collect
steps.desc: Earn up to 3 stars per level, unlock badges, and watch your journey path grow.

screenshots.title: Clean, colourful, and designed to keep kids focused on learning.

cta.title: Start your math adventure
cta.sub: Free to download. First 2 levels on us. Upgrade any time for unlimited access to all levels.
cta.note: Point your phone camera at the QR code to download instantly. No account required.
